We need to classify relation between two yes/no questions extracted from same actor at different times. Q1: "O Brasil deve regular os mercados digitais inspirando-se nas experiências internacionais, como a Lei de Mercados Digitais da União Europeia?" Q2: "O PL 2768/22 deve evitar a criação de políticas excessivas que possam sufocar a competitividade e a inovação nos mercados digitais?"

We need to see if they are same issue, opposite polarity, different, uncertain.

Q1 asks whether Brazil should regulate digital markets inspired by EU DMA. Q2 asks whether a specific bill (PL 2768/22) should avoid creating excessive policies that could stifle competition and innovation in digital markets.

These are different questions: one about general regulatory approach inspired by EU; the other about a specific bill avoiding excessive regulation. They are not the same issue; answer to one does not determine the other. So DIFFERENT.

Reasoning: they address different scopes (general policy vs specific legislative proposal) and different focus (adopting EU model vs avoiding overregulation). So DIFFERENT.
